edits.old: Use the complete post to interpret the meaning of the fragments. Describe what the fragments together specify about the post and what they leave unspecified. Do not fill in unspecified meaning from the complete post.
edits.new: Use the complete post to interpret the meaning of the fragments, including what they refer to. A fragment can represent a reaction to something identified elsewhere in the post without representing the meaning of that other text. Do not treat its reference as unspecified merely because the other text is unselected, or count that other text’s meaning as represented merely because the fragment refers to it. Describe what the fragments together specify about the post and what they leave unspecified. Apart from resolving references, do not fill in unspecified meaning from the complete post.
